title: Equipment-identity model provenance manifest
description: Shape enforced by scripts/equipment_identity/provenance.py's validate_manifest(). This schema documents the field shapes; it does NOT and cannot enforce the cross-file checks (trainingCodeCommit must resolve to a real commit in this repository, datasetId must not also appear in evaluationDatasets, artifactSha256/datasetHash must be well-formed sha256 strings) — those live in provenance.py because a static schema cannot express them. Treat this file as documentation plus structural validation, and provenance.py as the actual gate.

provenanceClass.description: FUTURE: every field below must be a concrete, verifiable value -- UNKNOWN/NOT_RECORDED/LEGACY are refused. HISTORICAL_GRANDFATHERED: for an already-existing model whose gaps are frozen evidence (today, only equipment_recognition@v1/@v2); placeholders are accepted but the manifest can never claim a promotion-track lifecycleState it wasn't evaluated to.

artifactSha256.description: For FUTURE: must match ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ (enforced in provenance.py, not by this pattern alone, so a HISTORICAL placeholder can still validate against this schema). For HISTORICAL_GRANDFATHERED: UNKNOWN/NOT_RECORDED/LEGACY also legal.

artifactBytes.description: Positive integer for FUTURE; UNKNOWN/NOT_RECORDED/LEGACY (string) legal for HISTORICAL_GRANDFATHERED.

trainingCodeCommit.description: For FUTURE: must resolve via `git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}` in this repository (checked in provenance.py, mirroring scripts/ml/training_run.py's _commit_exists -- the exact ML-2a guard). For HISTORICAL_GRANDFATHERED: UNKNOWN is the correct, permanent value for equipment_recognition@v1/@v2 -- the training pipeline was never under version control.

datasetHash.description: sha256 for FUTURE; UNKNOWN/NOT_RECORDED/LEGACY legal for HISTORICAL_GRANDFATHERED.

evaluationDatasets.description: For FUTURE: must be non-empty and must NOT contain datasetId (a model measured on its own training dataset reports its memory, not its generalisation).

lifecycleState.description: Must equal scripts/ml/lifecycle.py's TRANSITIONS keys exactly -- imported, not redeclared, in provenance.py.

rollbackTarget.description: A model id@version string, null, or NOT_RECORDED for a HISTORICAL_GRANDFATHERED entry with no recorded rollback plan.
